Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.channels

Interface ChannelsMeshInjectGateway

All Known Implementing Classes:
FailClosedChannelsMeshInjectGateway, VaultMeshChannelsMeshInjectGateway
public interface ChannelsMeshInjectGateway
Mesh CHANNELS bucket → LND channel-funding inject.

Decision-gate (authorizeOpen(long, java.lang.String)) must not mutate the ledger. Execution uses reserve → fund-bind (LND address) → LND open → commit (or release on open failure).

  • Method Details

    • authorizeOpen

      ChannelsMeshInjectGateway.InjectResult authorizeOpen(long amountSats, String peerPubkey)
      Checks whether an open may proceed using mesh CHANNELS capital without moving funds.

      This decision-gate operation must remain read-only: reservation, funding, and ledger consumption belong to the later execution methods.

      Parameters:
      amountSats - proposed local channel amount in satoshis
      peerPubkey - Lightning peer public key for the proposed channel
      Returns:
      allow/deny result and a stable reason code for policy or availability failure

    • reserveOpen

      default ChannelsMeshInjectGateway.DebitResult reserveOpen(String intentId, long amountSats, String peerPubkey)
      Soft-reserve CHANNELS capital for a specific open decision. Destination is the mesh allowlist tag ln-channel-rebalance (not the LN peer pubkey).

      Must be idempotent for the same intentId while the reservation is live (crash after reserve / before open retries the same decision).

      Parameters:
      intentId - stable id (typically channels-inject-open-<decisionId>) reused on retry of the same open decision
      amountSats - channel capital to reserve, in satoshis
      peerPubkey - Lightning peer associated with the open request
      Returns:
      authorized result with the durable intent ID, or refusal with a reason code

    • fundOpen

      default ChannelsMeshInjectGateway.FundResult fundOpen(String intentId, long amountSats, String lndFundingAddress)
      Builds, signs, and broadcasts a CHANNELS Taproot PSBT to the bound LND funding address.

      The funding transaction includes amount and fees, must use the CHANNELS key rather than the USERS omnibus key, and fails closed when construction, mesh signing, or broadcast fails.

      Parameters:
      intentId - durable mesh intent being funded
      amountSats - funding amount in satoshis
      lndFundingAddress - destination address returned by LND for channel opening
      Returns:
      funding authorization, optional transaction ID, and reason code

    • releaseOpen

      default ChannelsMeshInjectGateway.InjectResult releaseOpen(String intentId, long amountSats, String peerPubkey)
      Releases a soft reservation after LND openChannel fails.
      Parameters:
      intentId - durable intent holding the soft reservation
      amountSats - reserved amount in satoshis
      peerPubkey - peer originally associated with the open decision
      Returns:
      release outcome and reason code

    • commitOpen

      default ChannelsMeshInjectGateway.InjectResult commitOpen(String intentId)
      Durably consumes the reservation after LND reports a successful open.

      Repeated commit calls must be idempotent so outbox retries after a crash cannot consume the same intent twice.

      Parameters:
      intentId - durable reservation intent to commit
      Returns:
      commit outcome and reason code
